mappingProvenance.method: Live TypeScript imports from auditCatalogueSuites, the shared registry of executable browser suites. mappedCases is the exact URL join against case.sources across all registered case arrays.
mappingProvenance.semantics: A mapping identifies an executable scenario definition, not a passing result, full upstream transfer, or all branches reached. partial states the missing trigger/assertion; contract-gap requires a product contract decision; unsupported is reserved for explicitly unavailable capabilities. relatedCases do not establish source provenance. Run ledgers, including early failures and unsupported environments, remain separate evidence.
mappingProvenance.catalogueMetadataHashDefinition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify over live suite registration order, using suiteFile, casesExport, id, title, family, priority, sources in that field order.
